interpretive.purpose: A public, sanitized log of professional engineering activity: dated weekly entries recording shipped outcomes, patterns used, and lessons learned. Explicitly scrubbed of proprietary code, customer data, internal identifiers, and company-specific details.
consumers: Engineers, recruiters, or collaborators reviewing Christian's public work history and engineering patterns

components.name: log/
components.responsibility: Dated weekly activity-log entries (log/<year>/<year>-W##.md), the substantive content of this repo; template/weekly-template.md is the entry skeleton.

interpretive.data_flow_summary: No runtime data flow; this is a static content repository. Entries are appended by an external, separately-authored sync process whose commits carry the 'Professional Activity Mirror: <timestamp>' message pattern rather than being hand-committed here entry-by-entry.
operational_notes: Commit history is dominated by automated 'Professional Activity Mirror: <timestamp>' commits from an external sync process, not hand-authored commit messages per entry — expect that pattern when reading git log, not a gap in review.
